jobs.prompt: A 1536x1024 sprite sheet laid out as a strict 2-column by 4-row grid of eight equal cells, read left to right then top to bottom, showing one effect across eight animation frames: 1 anticipation, 2 release, 3 travel, 4 travel, 5 pre-contact, 6 contact peak, 7 reaction, 8 dissipation. Hand-painted storybook game VFX with dark confident outlines and restrained afterglow, matching the rendering, line weight and cell framing of the reference sheet exactly. The effect body only: no characters, no creatures, no scenery, no floor, no UI, no text, no numbers, no frame borders. Every cell sits on the same flat uniform cyan chroma background for keying. Critical: the effect itself must contain no cyan, aqua, turquoise or pale sky-blue anywhere, so it stays clearly separable from the cyan background when the background is keyed out. This is a hero's own skill, willed and composed — it should read as resolve, not as a threat. Even the final dissipation frame must still show a clearly visible shape, never fade to nothing. The effect is a circling gust that searches for a gap, finds one, and drives through it. Frame 1 thin wind lines begin to orbit. Frames 2-4 they tighten into a slow circling tempest, leaves and dust caught in the turn. Frame 6 the circle breaks and a single hard spear of wind lances through the opening. Frames 7-8 the tempest unwinds into drifting streaks. Palette: dusty lavender and deep indigo-violet, warm silver-lilac moonlight, cream highlights — the silver must lean warm and lilac, never blue-green.
